crossRefs.note: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have…
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
“They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her…
“Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by…
On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.
For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after…
I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense, when she decked herself with her earrings and…
Manasseh seduced Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that they did more evil than did the nations whom Yahweh…
See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will…
Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all…
Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have…
You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you…

translations.web: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have even taught the wicked women your ways.
translations.bsb: How skillfully you pursue love! Even the most immoral of women could learn from your ways.
translations.kjv: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
translations.asv: How trimmest thou thy way to seek love! therefore even the wicked women hast thou taught thy ways.
